title: AC1015+ VIEW handle-stream roles and spans
scope: Correct the R2000+ VIEW body-handle order and add transactional role/span evidence. This does not qualify full VIEW graph output or native view semantics.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: For R2000 and later, Base UCS Handle and Named UCS Handle remain in the VIEW handle stream even when the body HasUCS bit is false. Their two hard-pointer fields precede the R2007+ Live Section soft pointer.

changes: VIEW parsing now consumes the R2000+ base/named UCS handles independently of HasUCS, preserving subsequent Live Section alignment.

VIEW handle fields are bounded by the complete object handle-stream end and validate control/reactor soft pointers, optional xdictionary hard ownership, xref hard pointer, R2007+ background/visual-style/SUN roles, R2000+ UCS hard pointers, and R2007+ live-section soft pointer.
Canonical null fields require both null role code and zero target; malformed roles and truncation reset the record transactionally.
The parser records exact ordered handle bit spans; the encoder emits base/named UCS fields for every R2000+ VIEW regardless of HasUCS.

coverage: Independent encoder walk verifies expected field order, raw roles, targets and following sentinel.
Independent parser wire walk matches every recorded bit span, role and target.
Wrong-role refusal for each field, canonical nulls, final-field truncation, reset, copy/assignment and same-object corrected retry.

physical_read_check.readResult: 111/111 source frames published; zero entity/object parse failures; zero CRC mismatches; no VIEW handle-role mismatch observed.
physical_read_check.outputResult: Strict DXF output remains refused at the independent AC1027 source-reference gate: AC1027 DWG source references are not fully qualified. No output file was produced.

limits: Generated vectors establish the bounded codec behavior; the one physical source does not independently prove every VIEW producer's field profile.
VIEW target graph closure, associated UCS semantics, native consumer behavior, and strict whole-source output remain open.
The separate online AC1024 search found modern 2010-format samples, but none is an AutoCAD 2010 RTM provenance witness and that unrelated CLASSES discrepancy remains unresolved.
